purpose: UI direction concepts for discussion, not applied to the live website

concepts.name: A · 白陶工坊
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished, high fidelity desktop website screen concept, landscape 16:9, edge-to-edge flat UI image with no browser chrome and no device frame. This is a Chinese interactive pottery science/creative platform named "懂了鸭 / 窑变陶艺". The user dislikes the existing uniformly green backgrounds and controls, so propose a genuinely sophisticated new visual system. Show the actual glazing/painting workspace, NOT a landing page or finished exhibition scene. The central focus is a realistically rendered elegant small pottery jar, partly coated with cloudy celadon and plum glaze while part remains warm ivory clay; believable ceramic texture, photographic studio lighting, fine contact shadow. Interactivity should be clear from sparse rotation and zoom controls. Preserve usable actions: select glaze colors, brush/dip/pour techniques, brush size, enter kiln, return to form selection; top-right collection entry. Keep interface clear enough for a science education product, without a dense enterprise dashboard. Large canvas, excellent white space, concise controls, unmistakable active states. Fine Chinese serif display typography with clean readable sans-serif UI text. Render the following short Chinese labels accurately: "懂了鸭", "窑变陶艺", "01 选器", "02 施釉", "03 出窑", "我的作品架", "为器物绘制釉色", "釉色", "天青", "月白", "霁蓝", "铜红", "茶褐", "施釉方式", "刷釉", "浸釉", "淋釉", "笔触大小", "送入窑火", "返回选器". Highlight stage 02. Show five tactile miniature glazed ceramic swatches, one primary CTA, and minimal meaningful line icons. This must feel like a premium crafted website that can be built, not an abstract artwork. No green interface backgrounds, no green button tint, no mint glassmorphism, no fake lorem ipsum, no large decorative slogan beyond the specified heading, no watermark. Do not add branded hardware, avatars, charts, unnecessary clutter or photorealistic hands.
Direction A: warm, tactile, luminous pottery atelier. Palette: chalk white, oatmeal paper, pale warm stone, ink brown, and restrained fired-terracotta accents. Warm daytime atmosphere with very delicate paper grain, no full photographic room background. Calm compact top navigation on ivory. Main canvas occupies the left two thirds as an open warm-white work surface, jar centered large with a slight warm spotlight. A clean right-side control column with fine separators, generous padding, and small off-white ceramic swatch discs. Brush/dip/pour choices are simple outlined buttons. Small muted clay orange primary button "送入窑火" is anchored at bottom right. A softly rounded floating bottom toolbar within the canvas has brush size and zoom. Design small-radius rounded corners, understated relief, subtle human craft character, no heavy borders or gold luxury ornament. Beautiful quiet materials with genuinely modern usability. A strong warm-white visual impression instead of green.

Direction B: contemporary editorial art book and design museum, light and graphic. Palette: near-white art paper, graphite black, pale neutral gray, a precise ultramarine blue functional accent, occasional tiny terracotta markers. A striking oversized Chinese serif title on the upper left, beautifully aligned typography and fine black hairlines, an editorial asymmetric grid rather than rounded cards. The large jar is photographed against a pristine light-gray studio canvas occupying the central-left area, with a small vertical scale/ruler and rotation icon for interaction. Controls on the right are elegantly typeset, compact rows of glazed sample chips, horizontal technique tabs, a very clean line slider. Primary "送入窑火" button is solid ultramarine with white text; active stage 02 is a small ultramarine underline. Tiny captions and generous white space, refined visible functional hierarchy. Fewer containers, virtually no box shadows, mostly squared edges. It should feel bold, cultural, contemporary, collectible, airy, not beige country craft or SaaS. Use ultramarine only sparingly, never as a whole-page background. No green UI.

Direction C: atmospheric contemporary kiln laboratory, dramatically dark but highly usable. Palette: neutral charcoal and soft warm black, ash-gray surfaces, ivory text, restrained glowing burnt-orange and amber accents. Absolutely no forest-green or navy-green tint. The central jar is beautifully lit by a broad warm upper-right softbox and a subtle cool white rim, clearly readable against a matte charcoal workspace, with ceramic details visible rather than lost in shadow. Header is compact and elegant with thin light rules and an amber active stage. Canvas dominates left two thirds, a sparse bottom rail of rotation and zoom controls. Right column is an orderly instrument-like glazing console, matte charcoal rather than translucent glass, with luminous physical glaze swatches and clean ivory typography. Brush/dip/pour segmented controls are clear and restrained. A warm burnt-orange primary "送入窑火" button at the bottom is the main accent. Add one small discreet kiln-temperature/slow-cooling control row to convey experimentation, labeled only "烧成温度" and "缓冷", without graphs or decorative science fiction. Use modern Chinese typography, sensible 4–8px radii, refined spacing, subdued tactile textures. Premium cinematic mood that still reads like an easy-to-use educational creative tool. No neon, no holograms, no gilded luxury styling, no dark green.
